shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '400,630p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo REANCHOR_PRESENT; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#|validated by" src specs adrs 2>/dev/null | head -120 && rg -n "spec-names|changelog" package.json scripts .github && command -v lore-query-trace || true && git diff HEAD''^ HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md; do lore-query-trace --repo re-cinq/HALEngine --tests_covering "$f" 2>&1 || true; done
rg -n "runs another round after a tool call|asks for suppression when the tool says|joins the text of every round|validation-rejection text|keeps the usage an earlier|receives collected response text and usage" specs adrs src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts --runInBand -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator tool loop sums usage from the tool-request and answer rounds for afterModelResponse$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.scripts.test)\" && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts --runInBand -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator tool loop sums usage from the tool-request and answer rounds for afterModelResponse$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '445,580p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '38,78p' && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m 'Repair usage aggregation traceability' && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
